title: AndroidAPS crashes every time I enter the Omnipod tab
symptom: After upgrading to 3.0.0.1, AndroidAPS crashes every time the user enters the Omnipod tab. The user uses Omnipod Eros and OrangeLink for bridge. Restarting phone, link, and AndroidAPS, and rebuilding AndroidAPS did not help.
fix: The issue was resolved by using the dev branch instead of master. The user confirmed that the dev branch works without crashing.
evidence_quote: Dev branch is working for me, so closing this issue. Will try next master, when new version comes out.
